paragraphs: Chapter 443
Episode 127: To the Black King's Group (4)
Thud!
The thick handle of the axe-sword hit the back of Zephyrin's head. It wasn't someone who hit her, but an accident that happened when she bowed to Muraka.
"Ouch!"
As Zephyrin held the back of her head, Muraka couldn't help but beat his own chest with his fist in frustration.
It was hard to tell where someone like her had come from and was disrupting the discipline of the Third Army.
"I'm sorry, Commander!"
"Being sorry will end your mercenary life..."
"Oh, it's Sir Jin Runcandel!"
Zephyrin's eyes sparkled as she looked at Jin.
Jin and Murakan found it strange that this somewhat foolish-looking young woman could possibly be a demon dragon.
However, Murakan was carefully sniffing the scent coming from her.
-Murakan, how can a dragon like you be so dull? Oh, well. You're originally insensitive, anyway.
-I don't need to hear that from you.
-Didn't you smell anything from that human?
The conversation between Murakan and Quicantel at the Sword Emperor's banquet hall.
Zephyrin exuded a thick, terrible dragon blood smell that could not be detected by human sensory organs. It was the smell of mixed blood from several kinds of dragons.
Haaack!
Suddenly, Murakan let out a threatening sound and raised his fur.
He had finally caught the smell he couldn't detect at the banquet hall. Therefore, Murakan was ready to scratch Zephyrin's face with his sharp claws immediately.
"Eek!"
Zephyrin stepped back in surprise. Muraka understood that it was because Murakan showed his discomfort with her actions.
"...I'm really sorry, Sir Jin, and Murakan. The leader is still dealing with a previous guest, and once it's your turn, one of the subordinates will inform you."

Muraka suppressed his boiling anger as much as possible and spoke. Soon after, he disappeared with Zephyrin, leaving only Jin, Murakan, and the mercenaries on duty in the empty reception room hallway.
"Why did you do that just now? Did you smell what Quicantel mentioned before?"
"Meooow!"
"Transform and speak human."
Poof!
"Yes, it was that smell. If Quicantel hadn't told me, I think I would have missed it again because of the perfume smell."
"What do you think?"
"Do you think that girl is a demon dragon?"
"Well, it could be the smell coming from her weapon, as Quicantel said."
If Jephrine was a demon dragon, the two encounters they had so far might not have been coincidental.
In that case, the only reason Jephrine would approach them intentionally would be for Rontelgius's grimoire.
'Do they really want to meet the first generation just like that?'
According to Murca, Jephrine carried around the axe-sword, which they couldn't use properly, because of their admiration for Luna.
If she was a pure human, it would be just a quirky thing, but suddenly, Luna's acquisition of the "Pendant of Orgal" came to mind.
'My sister said she got the pendant after defeating a demon.'
A pendant obtained by defeating a demon, a grimoire obtained by killing a demon, and a demon dragon.
It seemed like a perfectly fitting puzzle, rather than just a coincidence. When Jin mentioned this, Murcan nodded and replied,
"Let's just ask the Black King leader directly after we finish our business. Are you a demon dragon? We couldn't ask at the banquet, but it's bothering me."
"Yeah, that's better. They won't tell us straight away, though."

"Don't worry, there's a way to find out. Anyway, if they turn out to be a demon dragon, we can look into your brother's relationship with Rontelgius. We'll beat them until they spill everything they know."
"What if they're stronger than us?"
"Where in the world would there be a dragon stronger than this Murcan... huh, yeah. I haven't fully recovered yet, so it's possible. Then we'll have to run away, I guess."
Jin shrugged his shoulders.
"By the way, the guy inside, seemed to be Runcandel. Considering how Jephrine wanted to meet the first generation."
"Either one of the higher-ranked members or their representative. Probably from the second generation."
Considering the conflict with the Council of Elders, Joshua needed a force to replenish his lacking power. As the next head, he needed to show that he could capture and rally neutral forces.
'But the Black King's group has maintained its neutrality for a long time, and it won't be easy to capture them without a significant offer.'
Whoever was meeting with the Black King leader now, if they came to 'capture' them rather than simply make a request, they might have a significant card to play.
Servants brought simple refreshments and tea. The two quietly waited for their turn, nibbling on the snacks.
The door to the Black King leader's reception room opened around 3 a.m.
"I'll see you tomorrow morning, Black King leader."
"Understood."
The voices of the Black King leader and the guest were heard.
From the conversation, it seemed they intended to continue their discussion tomorrow.
The figure that came out of the reception room was covered in a robe and hood, but Jin recognized at once that he was not Joshua or another higher-ranked member, but their representative.
He, too, recognized Jin and Murcan. He tried to walk past them without saying anything, but Jin spoke to him first.
"Hey."
The robed figure stopped and looked back at Jin.
"You, you're that guy from back then, right?"
That guy from back then.
At the Geomhwang Castle banquet hall, Jin was certain that the robed figure was the Black Knight who had tried to abduct Dante when they encountered each other.
"I was confused, but now that you've passed by closely, I can tell for sure. Users of the claw have a slightly noticeable way of walking. Should I call it a unique gesture?"
The claw was not a commonly used weapon, but Jin, who had been with Gilly for a long time, knew its characteristics well.

"It seems that the 2nd generation has entrusted quite an important matter, considering they sent a Black Knight. Tell me what kind of conversation was going on inside. I need to meet the Black King's Brigade Commander right now."
"...You're still good at teasing. It seems you're not afraid since you have the Black Dragon by your side."
"Well, I don't think it was much different when I first met you without Murakan. If we had fought to the end back then, would you be alive and able to find this place now?"
The robed figure turned around without responding. They seemed to think that dealing with Jin could lead to trouble with Murakan as well.
"Tell the Black Knights. I'm always open."
"There will be no day when the Black Helmets become your swords."
"You better remember that too."
When the robed figure left, the mercenaries on duty sent a signal to enter the Black King's Brigade Commander's reception room.
"Please come in."
"By the way, just in case, Murakan."
"What?"
"If the Black King's Brigade Commander is not as polite as you expect, you shouldn't say things like 'Look at me kindly' or 'I'll let you off the hook.'"
"...Do I look like a fool?"
"I'm just worried."
"Tsk."
At the end of the not-so-spacious hallway, the reception room boasted an impressively wide grandeur.
The large windows let the moonlight and starlight pour down from the stunning ceiling. It was a dreamy sight that didn't fit the dark profession of a mercenary.
Underneath that, Black King's Brigade Commander 'Valkas Cran' was seated at a desk to greet the two.
Amella of Gaipa's Mercenary Army, Black King's Brigade Commander Valkas Cran, and Ghost Captain Lata Proch. Among the world's top three mercenaries, he competed with Amella for ranking.
'Certainly, compared to Lata, he has a much more powerful presence.'
The first impression of Valkas, he seemed taller than Jin even while sitting.

Jin didn't know much more about him than most people. In other words, he only knew about the legendary feats he achieved before becoming the commander, how great his martial skills were, and roughly what kind of personality he had.
He had never encountered him in his past life or his current life. He wasn't a person with much known external information either.
- Valkas Cran. Hmm, he's more romantic than I thought.
- What?
- Should I say he cares tremendously about his family? The reason why the Black King's Brigade, the world's best mercenary group, is generally harmonious is precisely because of that.
- I see.
- The problem is that, aside from his family, he treats the rest of humanity as either clients who pay money or living pieces of meat.
Before finding the Black King's group, Jin recalled what Talaris had said about Valkas.
'Is it because he cares for his subordinates that even when Jephryn makes such a mistake, it only ends with anger?'
Or, did Valkas also suspect Jephryn and ordered him to be closely watched?
The latter seemed more likely. No matter how much he cared for his subordinates, the Black King's group was known for its strong and sharp military discipline.
Valkas raised his hand and opened his mouth.
"Welcome, the 12th generation of Runcandel."
"It's an honor to meet you, Commander Valkas. Thank you for your hospitality."
"It's not much of a hospitality. Is the person beside you the great Black Dragon?"
Despite the somewhat disrespectful tone, Murakan silently nodded.
Fortunately, Valkas did not commit any further rudeness.
"My subordinates talk about you quite a lot. It seems that the memory of escorting young you has remained as quite a pleasant memory for the 3rd Army."
"Is that so?"

"And even if they're not my subordinates, the 12th generation of Runcandel is the hottest figure in the world right now. There's bound to be talk everywhere. I also wanted to meet you once out of curiosity."
Jin and Valkas. The two smiling people's gazes met.
For some reason, Jin felt that he was being scrutinized as to why he had come to request a task.
And that feeling became a reality in just a few seconds.
"I assume you came to me to request protection for the city of Tikan. Am I wrong?"
Although Jin was slightly taken aback, he did not show it and nodded.
"It's as if you've mistaken me for having given you a letter detailing my request in advance. That's right, Commander Valkas."
The need for 'Tikan protection measures' for Jin was a matter that most of the world's powerful people were aware of to some extent.
Valkas couldn't possibly not know.
Moreover, Valkas had just dealt with Joshua's agent, so he was even more aware of the issue.
"Unfortunately, I don't think I can accept that request."
"You haven't even heard the conditions, have you?"
"That's true, but it means you're a step late."
Joshua didn't send someone to capture the Black King's group.
He had sent someone to make sure the Black King's group 'did not' accept Jin's request.
